node.title: Nongeneric mismatch descent preserves excess and has bounded depth
node.statement: In a recursive nongeneric full-zero mismatch chain, a transition with external zero count d sends (N,K,A) to N'<=N-A, K'=K-d, A'=A-d. Thus h=A-K is invariant and every live transition decreases ambient length by at least h+1. A chain from length n has at most floor(n/(h+1))-1 transitions. The six clean candidate caps are 169,169,255,254,254,510, each below its deciding scale 256 or 512. This proves depth, not branch width or slope aggregation.
